questions.prompt: Which Roman emperor is said to have made his horse a senator?
questions.fact: The story comes from hostile sources written decades later, and most historians now read it as a joke about the Senate.

questions.prompt: Which chemical process turns grape juice into wine?
questions.fact: Yeast does the work, and it stops when the alcohol it produces reaches a level that kills it.

questions.prompt: How many holes must a golfer complete to make the cut in a standard major?
questions.fact: Roughly half the field goes home at that point, and missing it usually means earning nothing at all for the week.

questions.prompt: Which film features the line about there being no place like home?
questions.fact: The ruby slippers were silver in the original book. They were changed to show off colour film.

questions.prompt: Which US state has the longest coastline?
questions.fact: Its coastline is longer than all the other states put together, thanks to an enormously indented shore.

questions.prompt: Which author wrote the Earthsea series?
questions.fact: She wrote its protagonist as dark-skinned in 1968, and spent decades objecting to cover artists who ignored it.

questions.prompt: Which early computer network was funded by the US Department of Defense?
questions.fact: The idea that it was built to survive a nuclear war is disputed; its designers say it was mostly about sharing scarce computers.
